title: A Conceptual Framework for Ethical Evaluation of Machine Learning Systems

bias_targets.target: General algorithmic bias and ethical harms
bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not empirically measure specific biases in a dataset or model. Instead, it proposes a conceptual utility framework to evaluate and balance potential ethical harms (such as unfairness, lack of demographic/geographic representation, and cultural insensitivity) against information gain and resource costs during the machine learning testing and evaluation lifecycle.
